# Phil Riehlman
## Phil Riehlman
### Signature
**Philip Oscar Riehlman** is a Hot Wheels designer that has been designing Hot Wheels cars since 1993. His first designs were the Twin Mill II and the Silhouette II as collaborations with Bruce Baur ; he also designed briefly for sister line Matchbox and currently also serves as a senior manager of Mattel.
He was lead designer for the Hot Wheels id line prior to its cancelation and currently designs models for Premium and the mainline; he is the lead designer for Premium 1:43 and Elite 64 . He initially worked as an intern in 1991 before applying for a permanent position at the Male Action Figures department in 1993; he was subsequently transferred back to the Hot Wheels department, where he has been ever since.
